description: This file defines the QualificationsMenuConfigurator class which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It is responsible for configuring menu items related to qualifications in the OrangeHRM administrative menu, specifically overriding screen actions for qualification-related views.

classes.name: QualificationsMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for qualifications in the admin module, overriding screen URL actions.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen action URL to replace 'save' with 'view' in the URL, inserting module-specific behavior.
